Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_06047_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_06047_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_06047 (
  input clk,
  input rstn,
  input tic_enable,
  input [28:0] f_control,
  output reg [31:0] carrier_val,
  output reg i_sign,
  output reg i_mag,
  output reg q_sign,
  output reg q_mag
);

  reg [29:0] accum_reg;
  reg [21:0] cycle_count_reg;
   
  wire [3:0] phase_key;
  wire [30:0] accum_sum;
  wire accum_carry;
  wire [31:0] combined_carr_value;
   
  always @ (posedge clk or negedge rstn) begin
    if (!rstn)
      accum_reg <= 0;
    else
      accum_reg <= accum_sum[29:0];
  end

  assign accum_sum = {1'b0, accum_reg} + {2'b0, f_control};
  assign accum_carry = accum_sum[30];
  assign phase_key = accum_sum[29:26];
  assign combined_carr_value[9:0] = accum_reg[29:20];
  assign combined_carr_value[31:10] = cycle_count_reg;
   
  always @ (posedge clk or negedge rstn) begin
    if (!rstn)
      cycle_count_reg <= 0;
    else if (tic_enable) begin
      carrier_val <= combined_carr_value; 
      cycle_count_reg <= 0; 
    end else if (accum_carry) begin
      cycle_count_reg <= cycle_count_reg + 1;
    end
  end
  
  always @ (*) begin
    case (phase_key)
      4'hF, 4'h0: begin
        i_sign = 0;
        i_mag  = 0;
        q_sign = 1;
        q_mag  = 1;
      end
      4'h1, 4'h2: begin
        i_sign = 1;
        i_mag  = 0;
        q_sign = 1;
        q_mag  = 1;
      end
      4'h3, 4'h4: begin
        i_sign = 1;
        i_mag  = 1;
        q_sign = 1;
        q_mag  = 0;
      end
      4'h5, 4'h6: begin
        i_sign = 1;
        i_mag  = 1;
        q_sign = 0;
        q_mag  = 0;
      end
      4'h7, 4'h8: begin
        i_sign = 1;
        i_mag  = 0;
        q_sign = 0;
        q_mag  = 1;
      end
      4'h9, 4'hA: begin
        i_sign = 0;
        i_mag  = 0;
        q_sign = 0;
        q_mag  = 1;
      end
      4'hB, 4'hC: begin
        i_sign = 0;
        i_mag  = 1;
        q_sign = 0;
        q_mag  = 0;
      end
      4'hD, 4'hE: begin
        i_sign = 0;
        i_mag  = 1;
        q_sign = 1;
        q_mag  = 0;
      end
      default: begin
        i_sign = 0;
        i_mag  = 0;
        q_sign = 0;
        q_mag  = 0;
      end
    endcase
  end

endmodule
